title: INDUSTRIAL BEAST 3000
body:
THIS IS NOT A NORMAL FAN. This is for warehouses, gyms, and people who take airflow VERY seriously. Will move small objects.

Features:
- 36" diameter
- ALL METAL construction
- 9500 CFM
- 3-phase motor
- OSHA compliant
- May cause papers to fly
summary: THIS IS NOT A NORMAL FAN. For warehouses, gyms, and people who take airflow VERY seriously.

comments.content: This is literally just fans. Like, actual fans. Ceiling fans.
